set: A: the page as a web page: at rest and in the three keys, and the text and controls at their real size

issues.where: Audio volume field, bottom right, above the Continue button
issues.what: when the dial panel opens it pushes the rows below down, and the Audio volume field ends up about 20px above the footer line and Continue. The bottom of the form looks squeezed and close to overlapping, which reads as a layout mistake rather than something happening to the page
issues.fix: reserve space below the last field, or open the panel as an overlay, so there is always at least a 48px gap between the last field and the footer

issues.where: crank panel bottom edge vs the Continue button, lower right
issues.what: the open crank panel ends about 20px above Continue and nearly touches its top-left curve. Continue looks crowded by the panel
issues.fix: move the footer down or keep a fixed minimum gap. Better still, let the page grow and scroll so the footer is never jammed against an open panel

issues.what: every field is an empty box with only a chevron: no placeholder, no value, no hint. A phone number and a date of birth look like select menus, so at rest it is unclear what each one takes or that you can type in it
issues.fix: add muted placeholder text in each field (for example '(555) 000-0000', 'MM / DD / YYYY', '0%') so each one reads as a usable input before it is opened

issues.what: step 1 looks the same as the upcoming steps 3 to 5, so there is no 'done' state. The track between knobs gives no sense of progress
issues.fix: give completed steps a distinct state (a checkmark, or a filled section of track between 1 and 2) and keep upcoming steps neutral

issues.where: vertical rhythm between the subtitle and the first field
issues.what: the subtitle sits about 44px above 'Contact number', but the gaps between rows are about 108px, and there is a large empty band of about 200px above the footer. Spacing feels uneven and the form floats high
issues.fix: increase the gap between the intro and the first row to about 1.5 times the row gap and tighten the row gaps a little, or centre the form block vertically

issues.where: Continue button, lower right of the button crop
issues.what: the bright white rim sits offset to the lower right of the pill and looks like a misregistered second outline rather than a highlight
issues.fix: make the highlight a thin, even inner bevel, or reduce its opacity so it doesn't read as a doubled edge

issues.what: Continue is grey and low contrast with no disabled cue, so you can't tell whether it is the primary action or disabled. The orange accent is used for the stepper but not for the main action
issues.fix: give the primary button the orange accent, or a clearer disabled treatment with a reason shown
